callees.name: _elp_argv
callees.pre_condition: An ELP executable is available at a configured path or on PATH.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of strings representing the command and arguments to start ELP in a mode that accepts JSON-RPC requests on stdin and writes JSON-RPC responses to stdout.

callees.name: subprocess.Popen
callees.signature: Popen(argv, cwd, stdin=PIPE, stdout=PIPE, stderr=DEVNULL) -> Popen
callees.pre_condition: argv is a non-empty list of strings whose first element names an executable. cwd is an existing directory.
callees.post_condition: Creates and starts a child process executing the command specified by argv. The child's working directory is cwd. stdin is a writable pipe, stdout is a readable pipe, and stderr output is discarded.

callees.name: _JsonRpcReader.__init__
callees.pre_condition: stream is a readable file-like object that produces newline-delimited JSON text. messages is a mutable collection.
callees.post_condition: Initializes the reader to consume from stream and deposit parsed message objects into messages.

callees.name: _JsonRpcReader.start
callees.pre_condition: The reader has been initialized with a valid stream and message container.
callees.post_condition: Begins reading lines from the bound stream in a separate thread of execution, parsing each complete line as a JSON object and appending it to the bound messages container.
